disclosures.text: a device for attachment to a surface with a suction cup
the device comprises a measuring device for measuring the suction force
a device for attachment to a surface with a suction cup, comprising a measuring device for measuring the suction force
the device comprises a display for indicating the suction force
the measuring device and/or the display is electronic
the device comprises a power supply and/or is connectable to a power supply
the device comprises a housing, wherein the housing is smaller than the suction cup
the device comprises an actuating device for increasing the suction force
the device comprises a resilient element
the resilient element is exchangeable
the resilient element is a conical spring
the resilient element presses against the actuating device, which is mounted in a sleeve, counter to the suction force of the suction cup
a coil is arranged in both the actuating device and the sleeve holding it, allowing the displacement of the actuating device relative to the sleeve to be measured
the device comprises a pretensioning lever that fixes the actuating device against the force of the resilient element
the measuring device acts mechanically
the position of the suction plate relative to other fixed components is determined by markings
the measuring device uses a system of coils or other electronic elements
the position of moving and stationary parts is measured by a change in the electric field
the display shows the working position of the suction plate and thus the suction force
the display is mechanical-optical
position markings on the display provide information about the working position of the suction plate
the display includes warning markings indicating a change in suction force
the display is acoustic and/or optical
the device has a transmission function to send the holding force signal to a receiver
the receiver for the holding force signal is the attached device
measured suction force values are converted into a continuous display by an electronic evaluation unit
suction force is displayed in percentage or as an optical green-red bar
changing acoustic signals are generated based on suction force
the power supply is a battery or rechargeable battery housed in the device
the system is equipped with a solar module
the solar module is part of the housing
the power source is the device attached to the holder
the suction plate has a tab to facilitate detachment from the surface
the actuating device is an actuating button
the resilient element is a coil spring
the effective portion of the spring can be adjusted to set spring strength and suction force
the actuating button simultaneously measures the exact position control of the suction plate
position markings are applied to the actuating button, which also serves as the holding element for the compression spring
the actuating button is mounted in a precise guide of the housing for the suction plate
microswitches query the position of the actuating button
the actuating button has rings, recesses, or elevations of varying depths for microswitch detection
the pretensioning lever holds the actuating device completely within its sleeve
the actuating button does not protrude when held by the pretensioning lever
the position of the actuating button corresponds to the rest position of the suction cup, with its membrane fully extended
removing the pretensioning lever causes the resilient element to pull the suction cup away from the surface, creating maximum vacuum
the actuating button is pressed downwards to expel air from under the suction cup
the suction cup is sealed against a working surface by its rubber material
releasing the actuating button causes a compression spring to push it upwards, creating vacuum
the actuating button is connected to the suction cup via a connecting piece and a screw
the actuating button is held in the sleeve by the vacuum on the suction cup
the housing has an attachment device with a bore for mounting a small device holder
a colored marking is visible in the rest position of the device
the colored marking indicates the suction force during operation
if the vacuum decreases, one or more colored markings become visible
the suction cup membrane is in a relaxed state when the pretensioning lever is pushed over the actuating button
the device includes a ball head for attaching a small device with a corresponding counterpart
the position of the actuating button relative to the sleeve is measured by coils in both elements
the measurement result is evaluated by electronics on a circuit board
reference coils are used for evaluation of the measurement
the evaluation result is output via a light-emitting diode
the total travel of the actuating button in the sleeve is approximately 2 mm to 2.5 mm
the LED displays green for 0 mm to 0.6 mm travel
the LED displays yellow for 0.6 mm to 1.1 mm travel
the LED displays red for travel beyond 1.1 mm to indicate unsafe attachment
